media_refresh.method: Fresh browser viewport captures. Silent MP4 previews use only captured frames, repeated without blending or motion interpolation, with brief opening/closing holds. Scrolling advances in small steps to preserve readable text.
media_refresh.mdu_placement: Phone viewport, Avery Preview only; walkthrough ends before the wide class table. 9.5 seconds.
media_refresh.mdu_filtering: Live scheduler interaction captures: 70 classes, search Ballet (14), Level 3 (3), select the Tuesday favorite, clear filters (70 with favorite retained). Captured with the preview family; demo selection removed afterward. Edited into a silent, labeled walkthrough using held original frames, without interpolation.
media_refresh.family_flex: Desktop viewport from the scheduler banner through ages, styles, days and Find Your Classes. 12.3 seconds, encoded at the original capture resolution.
media_refresh.presentation: CSS device frames preserve the captured interface. Original archived screenshots retained; refreshed media replaces the long captures on the public timeline.

claim_limits: No enrollment uplift, conversion statistics, or completed multi-studio launch claims inferred. Studio Director email matching is not described as an API integration.
